crossRefs.note: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were…
For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”
He called one of the servants to him, and asked what was going on.
Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.

translations.web: They were all amazed, and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”
translations.bsb: Astounded and perplexed, they asked one another, “What does this mean?”
translations.kjv: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?
translations.asv: And they were all amazed, and were perplexed, saying one to another, What meaneth this?
